notes.title: Hide and Secret Treasure of the Ages trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
We have released the official Hide and Secret Treasure of the Ages trading cards which are now available on Steam. 

Includes: 
- 8 Unique Trading Cards! 
- 3 Background Themes! 
- 5 Emoticons! 
- Cool Badges to earn! 

Help Anna and Will defeat Jacques in Hide and Secret Treasure of the Ages and start collecting the trading cards today!
